content: Petili na Yohana bhangunlamiha ngwabhengwabhe
Linjubha limo pasaa tisa ya pamuhi, Petili na Yohani bhakighenda ku Kitutubhi kya Chapanga, lisaa alyo likibha ndo lisaa lya kuntundamila Chapanga.

Na akwo ku Kitutubhi kya Chapanga pakibhegha mundu yumo ywakabheghite ngwabhengwabhe kutandila kubhelekwa kwake. Kila linjubha kakigheghwa na kubhikwa munyumba ya Chapanga panlyango ghuukemitwe “Nlyango ghwa maha,” ghwa Kitutubhi kya Chapanga manjubha ghoha ngati kakapembelehe kuyupe utango kwa bhandu bhaayingiliti.
Mundu ayu pakaabhonite Petili na Yohana paaheghelela kuyingila mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga kakiayupa bhampeghe kilibhi kyohele kila.
Bhene bhakinhulutulila mehu, mbole Petili kakinng'ombela, “Ghutulole.”
Yula mundu kakialolekeha kunu pakihyubhalila pangi kaakingama kilibhi kyohele kuhuma kwa bhombe.

Habhu, Petili kakinng'ombela, “Megha ng'obhe na madini gha ngalabha, chepa nga maganga gha mahabha, peni kimmeghite nakyo ndaghupegha. Kwa lihina lya Yesu Kilisito ghwa ku Nasaleti ghuyime na ghutyange!”
Mbole Petili kakinkamula kwa kibhoko kyake kya nnilo na kakinnyinula, kamu hihundo hya maghulu ghake hikikangamala.
Kakihumbahumba na Kakiyima kakiyanda kutyanga. Kakiyingila mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga papamu na Petili na Yohana pakityanga kunu pakihumba na kunntika Chapanga.
Bhandu bhoha bhaabheghiti apwo bhakimmona paakityanga na kunntika Chapanga.
Bhandu bhaking'amula kukita ndo yula ywakatamiteghe panji ya nlyango ghukemitweghe “Nlyango ghwa maha” ghwa Nyumba ya Chapanga, pakayupa utango, nabho bhakikangacha kwa ghala ghaanbwitukiliti.
Malandamiho gha Petili mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga
Yula mundu ngwabhengwabhe ywakalamihitwe pakabheghite mu kulongohana na Petili na Yohana, bhandu bhoha bhakikangacha munu, bhakiabhutukila mbaka ku ludamu lwa Solomoni.

Hino Petili pakaabhonite bhandu abho akwemukana kakiaghombela, “Mwenga Makaaisilaeli kiyaha niki mungughukangacha nhalo aghu? Bhuli mungutuhulutulila meho kwa ngangacho handa bhula twenga tunntenda mundu ayu katyange kwa makakala na umaha ghwetu?

Chapanga ghwa tate bhetu Abulahamu na Isaka na Yakwobu, kankwiha Yesu ndumitumi ghwake peni mwenga mukinkamula ngati kakwomwe na mukinlema muulongolo ghwa Pilato hata handa Pilato kakipala kannekekeha.
Kakibha nng'anyimo na ywa maha, peni mwenga mukinnema na mukinpala mundu yungi ywakabheghite nhakata kalekekehwe.
Mukinkoma ywaabheghite kihina kya ubhumi peni Chapanga kakinhyuha kuhuma kwa ahweghiti, na twenga ndo ayimiho ghwa mihalo ayi.
Lihina lya Yesu na uhyubhalilo mu lihina alyo ndo himpegha makakala mundu ayu yumummona na kunng'amula. Uhyubhalilo ghwake kwa Yesu ndo ghuunnamihite kyanalumu mundu ayu handa pamummona mabhoha.”
“Hinu maalongo bhangu, nungumanya kukita mukitenda agho kya nga kumanya handa paatendite hilongohi bhenu.
Peni Chapanga kahotola kila kyakalondoliti kwa ngulu ya ambuye bhake bhoha, kukita yingwiliha Kilisito ghwake kabamandwe.
Hinu, mulipetule na mummuyile Chapanga, ngati mwene kaabhuhile ulemwa ghwenu.
Nntende naha ngati Chapanga kaapeghe nndaluko ghwa chekwa mu mwoyo ghwenu na kuagheghela Kilisito ywakanhaghulilite mwenga ywene ndo Yesu.
Ywombe yingwiliha kahighale akwo kunani kwa Chapanga mbaka paghuhika nndaluko ghwa kutengelekehwa hilibhi hyoha, handa pakalongiliti Chapanga kwa ngulu ya Ambuye bhake bhoha kutandila makachu.
Kiyaha Musa kakilongela, ‘Bambo Chapanga ghwenu kaabhapegha mwenga mbuyi kuhuma mu nkati yenu handa pakang'eghite nenga, yibhakwiliha kunnyitikila aywo kwa kila nnando ghwakabhaghombela.
Mundu ywohele yula ywakalema kunnyitikila mbuye aywo, kaabhikwa pambwegha na bhandu bha Chapanga na kaakanjaghanwa.’
Hilahila Mambuye bhoha bha Chapanga kutandila kwa Samweli na bhala bha mbole yake, bhakilondola mihalo yiitendeka mu manjubha agha.

Chapanga kakiapegha mwenga naghilo kukindila ambuye bhake kwa kya mwenga na mwenga mungulilunga na lila ninganilo lyakatendite Chapanga na hukulu bhenu, handa pakannongilite Abulahamu, ‘Kukindila ubheleko ghwakwo aghanja bhoha bha nnima bhaanonelwa.’
Chapanga kakinhyuha Yesu nndumitumi ghwake, kakinlaghila kwa mwenga huti, ngati kabhayeghele nonelo kwa kuatenda kila yomo ywenu kalekane nalumu na uhokelo ghwake.”
